_help: Which Discord channel gets which alerts. The bot links each channel's webhook and keeps its routes in sync every 10 minutes (or /layout apply). A channel can have several routes; an alert posts once per channel. Route fields: retailer (id) or adapter (every retailer using it), store (online | instore), game (pokemon, one_piece, riftbound, mtg, lorcana, yugioh, gundam, dragonball), events (new_product, restock, qty_change, price_change, out_of_stock, spotted; default all but out_of_stock), keywords, role (role id to ping), in_stock (true: skip new listings that are sold out when first seen; their restock still alerts). 'was' lists old names to rename from.
